method.description: Heaps growth 10→100 files → project to 1000-file horizon; recommend bucket by load-factor 2×d_hat with semantic caps. Strict 1% collision kept as reference only.
method.primary_horizon: 1000 files (default); climbing uses geo-mean of 1k and 10k hats

tiers.near_const: d in [2,4] and top1>=0.5 → tiny optional table
tiers.saturated: d100<=512 and alpha<0.35 → closed enum, tight buckets

method.why_not_strict_1pct: Uniform 1% collision needs B≈50×d; infeasible for multi-million ID spaces. Load≈0.5 (collision≈20%) matches common hashed-ID practice.
method.climbing_bucket_plan: For climbing tier, size buckets from geo_mean(d_hat_1k, d_hat_10k) ≈ ~3k-file horizon
